hero.title: A Legacy of Craftsmanship
hero.description: For over 60 years, Shri Swami Jewellers has stood for honest work, traditional knowledge and a personal connection with every customer.

founder.name: Shri Swamy Nath Sah
bioParagraphs: In 1966, our grandfather, Shri Swamy Nath Sah, started this journey in Shitalpur, Ekma (Saran, Bihar) with a simple yet powerful belief — to create beautiful, durable and meaningful jewellery for the people of our community.
His exceptional craftsmanship, honesty and personal care earned him immense trust and respect, and laid the foundation of what Shri Swami Jewellers stands for today.
founder.quote: For him, jewellery was not just an ornament, but a part of people's traditions, emotions and life's special moments.

journey.title: From a Small Workshop to Three Generations of Trust

timeline.description: Started by Shri Swamy Nath Sah in Shitalpur, Ekma (Saran, Bihar).
A tradition of craftsmanship, trust and personal relationships that continued for decades.
Serving customers in Delhi, Chhapra and Siwan with the same values.
